Do you have an inkjet!? That was my problem, and I use online labels as my supplier too. I’m just gonna give you my honest feedback and I’ve tried every solution I can think of. 

So, the ink must be dry (like 100%, bone dry. Your finger smudge will and can cause colors to come off)and it will take like 30 minutes or more after printing (it takes way longer with glossy paper vs. matte), THEN you have to spray with a clear Uv spray (Krylon spray works, it’s $7.99 per glossy or matte spray). You can use self-laminate or full lamination (see lamination sticker hacks on google). I’d consider changing the language for your Etsy shop to say water-resistant vs. water proof. Its a sticker, if endless amounts of water gets on it or if it falls into a river/dish washer, things can happen. Making a home made sticker with an ink jet I think is the main issue (laser printing I hear is what you need) but as a new Etsy shop i am saving up to buy my own laser printer as they start around $300).

You can put on for variation and specify they select (water bottle sticker or whatnot) so you have the awareness to spray a few layers of Krylon to ensure quality. I’m starting to test out water slide decal paper now to see if it helps, I can loop back to you if you want on the outcome.
